== Summary ==
Identified: [[Jim Li]], [[Graham Neal]]. "Him Li" is a typo for Jim Li: the same gallery and the director's report name Jim Li as a contender, and no Him Li played. Which is which not marked.

== Description ==

Game 2: [[Jim Li]] vs. [[Graham Neal]] (captioned "Him Li"). At the [[2002 Bespin Regionals]], Coach's Corner, Apache Plaza Mall, St. Anthony, Minnesota, 15 June 2002.

== Source and credit ==

Published on the MNSWCCG website's "2002 Bespin Regional Weekend Pictures" page: [http://www.mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021102035753/http://www.mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html Internet Archive]. The page does not say who took the pictures; [[Nick Kolnik]], who ran the site, directed the event.
